cards.audioText: How many type ratings do you have?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有几种型別等级？
cards.referenceText: Now I am an airline transport pilot with type rating of A320, I hope I will fly A350 in future.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我现在是一名航线飞行员，有A320的型別等级签注，我希望我未来可以飞A350。

cards.audioText: Can you say something about the A320?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能介绍下A320型飞机吗？
cards.referenceText:
A320 is a short to medium range aircraft with two powerful turbofan engines. It has a single aisle and its maximum seating capacity is 158. A320 has fly-by-wire and is easy to control. It has advanced flight management system and greatly reduces the work load of pilot.

I don't fly Airbus aircraft so I'm not familiar with it, but I know Airbus is highly computerized. So, in abnormal situation, it can solve most of the problems automatically. It is fly-by-wire, which can reduce pilots' workload. Also in Airbus aircraft, the traditional control column has been replaced by side-sticks, thus
giving pilots more space in the cockpit.
cards.referenceTextZh:
A320系列是一款单通道双发中短程飞机，舱内设158个座位。A320操作便捷，采用电传操控系统。其先进的飞行管理系统，大幅减轻了飞行员的工作负荷。

我没飞过空客系列，所以我不了解A320，但我知道空客飞机是高度计算机化产品。遇到异常情况时，它可以自动解决大部分的问题。A320采用电传操纵，减轻了飞行员的工作负荷。另外，空客飞机采用侧置的操纵杆代替传统驾驶盘，为飞
行员提供了更多的座舱空间。

cards.audioText: Do you want to fly any new type of aircraft such as B787 or A380?
cards.audioTextZh: 你想驾驶新型飞机吗，如波音787或空客A380？
cards.referenceText: B787 is the dreamliner, and A380 is the biggest passenger aircraft in the world. The feeling of flying that kind of aircraft will be different. So, it would be great to have a chance to fly the big aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 波音787是梦幻客机，A380是世界上载客量最大的飞机。驾驶这些飞机会有不同的感觉。所以如果有机会能飞大飞机肯定很不错。

cards.audioText: What are some advantages of Airbus compared to Boeing?
cards.audioTextZh: 和波音系列相比，空中客车系列有哪些优点？
cards.referenceText:
Airbus is much more efficient and economical to operate than Boeing. Besides, Airbus pays more attention to the introduction of advanced technology to improve aircraft performance. For example, it was the first time to introduce digital fly-by-wire controls into an airliner, which facilitated the aircraft operation greatly.

Airbus is highly computerized. In abnormal situation, it can solve most problems automatically, but Boeing usually shows problems on warning display and pilots will have to do checklists and solve problems by themselves. Also in Airbus aircraft, the traditional control column has been replaced by side-sticks. Thus, pilots have more space in the cockpit than in Boeing aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh:
相比于波音系列，空客系列操作起来更加高效经济。另外，空客公司更加注重引进先进技术，提高飞机性能。例如，空客公司是首个使用数字电传操纵飞行控制系统的公司，极大地方便了飞机的操作。

空客飞机高度计算机化。遇到异常情况时，它可以自行解决大部分问题，而波音系列通常是在警告指示上显示，飞行员必须按照检查单自行解决问题。另外，空客系列已经采用侧置的操纵杆代替传统驾驶盘。飞行员在座舱内的活动空间比波音系列大。

cards.audioText: What type of aircraft did you fly in your flight school?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行学院时你飞过什么型号的飞机？
cards.referenceText: I flew TB-20 and PA-42 in my flight school. TB-20 is light, single engine, pistonpowered aircraft designed in the late 1970s. It has a variable pitch propeller, and it's the first of this class in Europe at that time. The Piper PA-42 Cheyenne is a turboprop aircraft built by Piper Aircraft. The PA-42 Cheyennes are developed from the earlier PA-31T Cheyennes I and II.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在飞行学院飞过TB-20和 PA-42。TB-20是一款小型单引擎活塞式飞机，设计于20世纪70年代。它配备了可变螺距螺旋桨，是当时欧洲同级别飞机中的翘楚。派珀PA-42系列是由派珀公司研发的涡轮螺旋桨飞机。派珀PA-42夏衍是在早期的PA-31T夏衍I和PA-31T夏衍II的基础上设计研发的。

cards.audioText: What was the aircraft you first flew?
cards.audioTextZh: 你第一次驾驶的飞机是什么型号？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft I first flew was C172, which was made in the US. It's a four-seat, single-engine, high-wing and fixed-wing aircraft. The cruising altitude of C172 is usually below 3000 meters. In C172, there's no pressurization system and air conditioning system, and its slow speed is good for pilots to enjoy the beautiful sceneries while flying. I flew C172 for about 120 hours. My flying experience with C172 was very interesting and memorable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我第一次驾驶的是塞斯纳172型飞机，产自美国。塞斯纳172是一款四座位单引擎上单翼固定翼飞机。其巡航高度通常在3000米以下，机舱内无增压系统和空气调节系统。另外，塞斯纳172的飞行速度较慢，适合飞行员欣赏途中的风景。我驾驶C172大约120小时，这些飞行经历既有趣又难忘。

cards.audioText: What are the main types of aircraft in your fleet?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们机队的主要机型有哪些？
cards.referenceText: Our fleet consists of more than one hundred Airbuses, more than seventy Boeings and some other aircraft like MD, CRJ, and ERJ.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们机队有100余架空客飞机，70余架波音型飞机，以及MD、CRJ、ERJ型飞机。

cards.audioText: What type of aircraft do you fly now? What other types have you flown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在飞什么机型？你还飞过其它机型么？
cards.referenceText: I fly A320 of Airbus family now, and I have flown Y-5, a single propeller aircraft, and MD82. They are conventional aircraft. The flight management and navigation systems are out of date, but the maneuverability of MD82 is excellent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我现在飞空客A320系列，之前飞过单螺旋桨的Y-5系列和MD82型飞机，它们都是传统型号的飞机。虽然飞行管理系统和导航系统都已过时，但MD82的机动性能仍很出色。

cards.audioText: Do you prefer flying two-engine or four-engine aircraft? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢驾驶双发飞机还是四发飞机？为什么？
cards.referenceText: In consideration of safety, I don't know which to choose, because both of them are designed to be very safe, even though a few of them had some accidents because of abnormal situations. While in view of comfort, I prefer two-engine aircraft, since they produce less noise and are more comfortable for passengers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 考虑到安全性，我不知道如何选择，因为两种飞机设计得都很安全。虽然其中一些机型因非正常情况出过事故。若考虑舒适性，我更喜欢双发飞机，因为其噪音小，更舒适。

cards.audioText: What type of aircraft do you fly? Can you say something about it?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞什么类型的飞机？你能介绍一下吗？
cards.referenceText: I fly C172, there are some aircraft systems in C172, such as electrical system, flight control system, landing gear, communication and navigation (hydraulic system, pressurization, air conditioning system, oxygen system).
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的是塞斯纳172，塞斯纳172有一些飞机系统，如电气系统，飞行控制系统，起落架，通信和导航系统(液压系统，增压系统，空调系统，氧气系统)。

cards.audioText: What type of aircraft do you fly? Can you say something about the aircraft you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在飞什么机型？你能说一下你现在飞的飞机吗？
cards.referenceText: I fly C172, there are some aircraft systems such as electrical system, flight control system, landing gear, communication and navigation systems (hydraulic system, pressurization, air conditioning system, oxygen system).
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞塞斯纳172, 塞斯纳172有很多飞机系统，比如电气系统，飞行控制系统，起落架，通讯和导航（液压系统，增压系统，空调系统，氧气系统）。

cards.audioText: How does the aircraft you fly now compare with the aircraft you flew during flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在所飞的航空器与飞行训练期间驾驶的航空器相比如何？
cards.referenceText: I am still in flight training, so the aircraft I fly now is the same DA-40 that I use for training. I like its predictable handling and modern cockpit, and it is suitable for learning normal procedures and instrument flying. I have not yet transitioned to a different aircraft type.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我仍在接受飞行训练，所以我现在驾驶的就是训练所用的 DA-40。我喜欢它稳定且易于预判的操纵特性和现代化驾驶舱，它适合学习正常程序和仪表飞行。我还没有改装到其他机型。

cards.audioText: What do you consider the main technological strengths and limitations of the aircraft type you currently fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为目前所飞机型的主要技术优势和局限性是什么？
cards.referenceText: I currently fly the C172. Its main strength is that it is easy to control, which makes it suitable for initial training. Its limitations include relatively modest operating altitude and endurance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我目前驾驶 C172。它的主要优点是容易操纵，因此适合初始训练。它的局限包括运行高度和续航能力相对有限。

cards.audioText: Do you like the aircraft type you currently fly, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢目前所飞的机型吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I like the aircraft I currently fly. It was the first aircraft I flew as a pilot, so it is special to me. It also performs well and is easy to control.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢目前驾驶的飞机。它是我作为飞行员驾驶的第一架飞机，所以对我来说很特别。它的性能也不错，而且容易操纵。

cards.audioText: Which aircraft types have you flown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞过哪些机型？
cards.referenceText: I have flown the DA-40 during my flight training. It is the only aircraft type I claim to have flown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在飞行训练期间驾驶过 DA-40。这是我唯一声称驾驶过的机型。

cards.audioText: Which aircraft type ratings have you held?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾持有哪些航空器型别等级？
cards.referenceText: I have not held an aircraft type rating. I am still training on the DA-40 at flight school, so I do not claim an airline-aircraft qualification. I would need to complete the approved training and checks before holding any type rating.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有取得任何型别等级。目前我仍在航校使用 DA-40 训练，因此不会声称自己具备航空公司飞机的资质。取得任何型别等级前，我都需要完成批准的训练和检查。

cards.audioText: What type of aircraft do you currently fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你目前飞哪种型号的飞机？
cards.referenceText: I am a student pilot, and I currently fly the DA-40 for flight training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是一名学员飞行员，目前使用 DA-40 进行飞行训练。

hotspot-2026-10-15-29023a596778: What type of aircraft do you fly?

cards.audioText: Which aircraft types are operated in your company's fleet?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所在公司的机队运营哪些机型？
cards.referenceText: I am not employed by an airline, so I do not have a company fleet. My flight school operates the DA-40, which is the aircraft I currently use for training. Other aircraft may be available at the school, but I do not claim to fly them.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我没有在航空公司任职，因此没有所谓的公司机队。我的航校使用 DA-40，这也是我目前用于训练的飞机。学校可能还有其他飞机，但我不会声称自己驾驶过它们。

cards.audioText: What are the main systems on the aircraft type you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞的机型有哪些主要系统？
cards.referenceText: The main systems on the aircraft I fly include the navigation, electrical, and communication systems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我所驾驶的飞机主要系统包括导航系统、电气系统和通信系统。

cards.audioText: What general differences do pilots notice between Boeing and Airbus flight decks?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员通常会注意到波音与空客驾驶舱之间有哪些差异？
cards.referenceText: A common difference is the primary control interface. Boeing flight decks typically use control columns, while Airbus flight decks use side-sticks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个常见区别是主要操纵装置。波音驾驶舱通常使用驾驶盘，而空客驾驶舱使用侧杆。

cards.audioText: Which type of aircraft would you like to fly, and why?
cards.taskTitle: 你想飞哪种型号的飞机？为什么？
cards.audioTextZh: 你想飞哪种型号的飞机？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I would like to fly the Airbus A320 because I am interested in its flight deck and fly-by-wire systems. It is widely used on airline routes, so learning to operate it would be useful for my career. However, safe operation and proper training are more important than my personal preference.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我想飞空客 A320，因为我对它的驾驶舱和电传操纵系统很感兴趣。这种机型广泛用于航空公司的航线，学习驾驶它对我的职业发展有帮助。不过，安全运行和规范训练比个人偏好更重要。

hotspot-2026-10-16-4235b14d8b8d: Which type of aircraft would you like to fly, and why?

cards.audioText: If you could choose, would you prefer to fly a Boeing or an Airbus aircraft, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果可以选择，你更愿意驾驶波音还是空客飞机？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I would prefer to fly an Airbus. Its side-stick layout provides more space around the pilot's seat, which I find comfortable. I also like its fly-by-wire technology because it can reduce pilot workload.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我更愿意驾驶空客飞机。它的侧杆布局让驾驶座周围有更大的空间，我觉得很舒适。我也喜欢它的电传操纵技术，因为这项技术可以减轻飞行员的工作负荷。

cards.audioText: What is the passenger capacity of the aircraft type you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞机型的载客量是多少？
cards.referenceText: I fly the C172, which can accommodate two passengers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的是 C172，它可以搭载两名乘客。

cards.audioText: What are the main operating limitations of the aircraft type you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞机型的主要运行限制有哪些？
cards.referenceText: I fly a DA-40, but the exact numerical limitations depend on the variant. The main limits cover airspeed, engine operation, aircraft weight and centre of gravity, manoeuvring and load factor, flap use, and approved weather or icing conditions. I obtain the applicable values from the flight manual and cockpit placards before flight; any demonstrated crosswind value is considered separately from a mandatory operating limitation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我驾驶 DA-40，但具体数值限制取决于不同型号。主要限制包括空速、发动机运行、飞机重量与重心、机动与载荷系数、襟翼使用，以及获准飞行的天气或结冰条件。飞行前，我会从飞行手册和驾驶舱标牌中获取适用数值；经验证的侧风值与强制性运行限制应分别看待。
